catalog.name: Satellite Precipitation
catalog.description: Satellite-derived precipitation estimates from multiple NASA missions providing global rainfall and precipitation measurements. These datasets complement ground-based observations and are essential for water resource management in data-sparse regions.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Data from NASA TRMM mission, GCOM-W1/AMSR2 by JAXA, and Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS). Processing by NASA Precipitation Processing System (PPS). Contact: earthdata-support@nasa.gov

info.name: License
info.content: NASA data is generally available for public use. Please cite appropriate missions and processing systems in publications.

info.name: Global Coverage Advantage
info.content: Satellite precipitation provides the only consistent global precipitation measurements, particularly valuable over oceans, remote regions, and areas with sparse ground-based rain gauge networks.

info.name: Applications
info.content: Water resource assessment, drought monitoring, flood forecasting, agricultural planning, climate research, numerical weather prediction model validation.

members.name: TRMM Precipitation Products
members.description: Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission (TRMM) provided the first dedicated satellite precipitation measurements in the tropics, establishing the foundation for global precipitation monitoring.

members.name: TRMM Precipitation Rate (Daily)
members.description: Daily precipitation rate from TRMM multi-satellite analysis covering tropical and subtropical regions with high-quality rain rate estimates.

info.name: Background
info.content: TRMM 3B42 combines precipitation radar, microwave imager, and infrared data from multiple satellites to produce high-quality precipitation estimates in the tropics and subtropics.

info.name: Coverage Area
info.content: 50°N to 50°S latitude, covering tropical and subtropical regions where most global precipitation occurs

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 0.25° × 0.25° spatial resolution (~25 km at equator)

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: January 1998 - April 2015, providing 17+ years of consistent tropical precipitation data

info.name: Measurement Units
info.content: Precipitation rate in millimeters per hour (mm/hr)

info.name: Multi-sensor Approach
info.content: Combines precipitation radar (high accuracy), passive microwave (all-weather), and infrared (high temporal/spatial sampling) for optimal precipitation retrieval

info.name: Applications
info.content: Tropical water resource assessment, monsoon analysis, hurricane precipitation studies, climate research, hydrological model validation

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA TRMM mission, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center Precipitation Processing System (PPS)

members.name: TRMM Precipitation Rate (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly precipitation rate from TRMM providing long-term tropical precipitation climatology and trend analysis capabilities.

info.name: Background
info.content: TRMM 3B43 provides monthly precipitation estimates by combining satellite data with rain gauge information where available, offering the best long-term tropical precipitation record.

info.name: Gauge Adjustment
info.content: Monthly estimates are adjusted using available rain gauge data through the Global Precipitation Climatology Centre (GPCC) dataset

info.name: Climate Value
info.content: Provides the most reliable long-term tropical precipitation record for climate studies, trend analysis, and seasonal pattern characterization

info.name: Applications
info.content: Climate change research, seasonal precipitation analysis, water resource climatology, monsoon trend studies, El Niño/La Niña impact assessment

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA TRMM mission, NASA GSFC PPS, Global Precipitation Climatology Centre (GPCC)

members.name: AMSR2 Precipitation Products
members.description: Advanced Microwave Scanning Radiometer 2 (AMSR2) precipitation products providing global precipitation measurements using passive microwave technology.

members.name: AMSR2 Surface Soil Moisture (Daily)
members.description: Daily global surface soil moisture from AMSR2 passive microwave measurements, providing all-weather soil moisture detection capability.

info.name: Background
info.content: AMSR2 uses passive microwave radiometry to detect precipitation through its interaction with microwave radiation. This approach works through clouds and provides global coverage.

info.name: Measurement Principle
info.content: Detects microwave emission and scattering signatures of precipitation particles, enabling precipitation retrieval under all weather conditions

info.name: Global Coverage
info.content: Complete global coverage between 89°N and 89°S with daily revisit capability

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 10-25 km spatial resolution depending on microwave frequency used

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: July 2012 to present, continuing operations

info.name: All-weather Capability
info.content: Microwave measurements can penetrate clouds, providing precipitation estimates regardless of cloud cover or lighting conditions

info.name: Applications
info.content: Global precipitation monitoring, numerical weather prediction, water cycle studies, complement to radar and gauge measurements

info.name: Attribution
info.content: JAXA GCOM-W1/AMSR2 mission, NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) program

members.name: AMSR2 Surface Soil Moisture (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly surface soil moisture from AMSR2 providing stable, long-term soil moisture climatology for global water cycle analysis and climate studies.

info.name: Background
info.content: Monthly AMSR2 rain rate provides temporal averaging that reduces noise and provides stable precipitation climatology suitable for long-term analysis and climate studies.

info.name: Temporal Stability
info.content: Monthly averaging reduces day-to-day variability and provides more stable precipitation patterns for climate analysis

info.name: Climate Applications
info.content: Suitable for precipitation trend analysis, seasonal cycle characterization, interannual variability studies, and water balance calculations

info.name: Applications
info.content: Water resource climatology, seasonal forecasting support, climate model validation, long-term water balance studies

info.name: Attribution
info.content: JAXA GCOM-W1/AMSR2 mission, NASA climate data processing

members.name: Lightning and Convective Activity
members.description: Lightning data providing insights into convective precipitation processes and storm intensity, complementing direct precipitation measurements.

members.name: OLS Digital Derived Lightning
members.description: Digital derived lightning from OLS providing information on convective intensity and storm activity patterns.

info.name: Background
info.content: The Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS) on TRMM detected lightning flashes across the tropics, providing unique information about convective activity and its relationship to precipitation processes.

info.name: Lightning-Precipitation Relationship
info.content: Lightning activity is closely related to convective precipitation intensity, making it valuable for understanding storm dynamics and precipitation processes

info.name: Coverage Area
info.content: 35°N to 35°S latitude, covering the main tropical convective regions

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 1995-2013, providing nearly two decades of tropical lightning climatology

info.name: Scientific Value
info.content: Provides insights into convective intensity, storm electrification processes, and relationships between lightning and precipitation

info.name: Applications
info.content: Convective precipitation analysis, storm intensity studies, precipitation process research, severe weather climatology, thunderstorm frequency mapping

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA TRMM Lightning Imaging Sensor (LIS) team, NASA Marshall Space Flight Center

members.name: Precipitation Analysis Products
members.description: Advanced precipitation analysis products combining multiple data sources for comprehensive precipitation monitoring and research.

members.name: MERRA-2 Convective Rainwater Source (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly convective rainwater source from MERRA-2 reanalysis at 700hPa level for comprehensive atmospheric moisture analysis.

info.name: Background
info.content: Combines precipitation estimates from multiple satellite missions to provide the most comprehensive global precipitation analysis available from space-based observations.

info.name: Multi-mission Approach
info.content: Integrates data from TRMM, GPM, AMSR2, and other satellite missions to provide optimal global precipitation coverage

info.name: Global Coverage
info.content: Complete global coverage from pole to pole, including regions not covered by individual missions

info.name: Applications
info.content: Global water cycle studies, climate model validation, water resource assessment, drought and flood monitoring, precipitation trend analysis

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) program, multi-mission precipitation analysis team
